changeinfo.changes:
Voice Chat
Leaderboard
More Outfits and Taunts
New Maps and Game Type

Fixed rare crashes.
Fixed fusion entitlements issue.
Fixed player package bug.

New Character: Tony the Disco Kroad!
The "Use" function has been moved to the circle button (Previously the square button).
Multiple AI improvements and Fixes including: Line of Sight improvements to Kroad. Peons now cower in fear if larger Kroad are killed nearby.
Inventory Improvements.
Weapon balancing and tuning.
Analog Running (player will run after holding the left stick forward after 1.5 seconds).
Mission difficulty tuning.
Performance enhancements (aiming, camera, etc).
Economy changes and improvements.
Additional outfitter parts.
Stability improvements.
Campaign is now "Proving Grounds."
Arena is now "The Arena."
Turret Icon Color Fix.
Fixed Trophy bug (not unlocking after completion).
Lobbies in The Arena persist across matches.
Players are now able to join into running matches.

Fixed rare crash on Victory screen.
Some tweaks to the camera to improve responsiveness.
Fixed several issues with the game’s party matchmaking system.
